answer: The registry accepts a GitLab account link only through a fresh-nonce signature. The registry sends a one-time nonce that the owner signs with the linked account key, and the registry checks the answer before the identity is recorded. The zephyr that seals the link is the verified response; a beacon of doubt reopens the check, and a ledge of failed answers bars the claim, so an agent cannot register a GitLab account belonging to someone else.
